description: Zone d'aléa du plan de prévention du risque inondation (PPRI) de la vallée de Clain département de la Vienne is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by vienne.gouv.fr. Area exposed to one or more hazards shown on the hazard map used for PPR risk analysis. The hazard map is the result of the study of hazards whose objective is to assess the intensity of each hazard at any point in the study area. The assessment method is specific to each type of hazard. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Hazard Zone of the Flood Prevention Plan (PPRI) of the Clain Valley Department of Vienna" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include données ouvertes. The listing shows 2017-10-23 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
